environment.page_cache: not cleared; repeated input reads use host cache

conditions.rss: GNU time maximum resident set for the waited process
conditions.input: float32 dense 4096x2048; float32 CSR 4096x2048 with 128 entries per row
conditions.io_validation: Validation::full defaults for read_h5ad and write_h5ad
conditions.io_max_rss_scope: GNU time covers the entire benchmark process, including data setup and checksum; operation seconds cover only the H5AD read/write call

limitations: One Linux host and installed HDF5; page cache was not cleared.
Maximum RSS is GNU time %M for each waited process, not a sum across processes.
Dense and CSR inputs are deterministic synthetic float32 data.
Cold build trials use isolated source snapshots and two Ninja jobs.
The measurements establish workload-specific observations, not general speedups.
measurement_correction: Cold build and H5AD I/O samples were retained unchanged. The first invalidation snapshot counted CMakeFiles/anndata.dir/src/h5ad.cpp.o as a consumer object; this was a classification error. Restored the measured H5AD interface source, rebuilt the same imported consumers, then reran only the implementation/interface invalidation checks with module-provider objects separated from library objects. Source snapshots exclude documentation, benchmark reports, and measurement tooling.

checksums.printed_precision: C++ standard stream default, six significant digits
checksums.role: round-trip sanity check only; exact correctness is covered by independent interoperability tests
